facts.evidence: Q2 2026 reported sales were $25.3 billion, representing a 6.6% increase year-over-year.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 reported sales were $25.3 billion.
Q2 2026 reported sales increased 6.6% year-over-year.
Q2 2026 reported diluted EPS was $2.27.
Q2 2026 reported diluted EPS was a 0.9% decrease from the prior year.
Non-GAAP adjusted EPS for Q2 2026 was $2.90.
Q2 2026 adjusted EPS was up 4.7% from the prior year.
Non-GAAP free cash flow for Q2 2026 was approximately $8.7 billion, compared to $6.2 billion in the prior year.
claims.note: Period error: the release footnotes the ~$8,700M (and the $6,214M comparative) as second-quarter YTD 2026, estimated as of July 15, 2026 — not a standalone quarterly figure.

claims.claim: The company increased its full-year 2026 estimated reported sales guidance to a midpoint of $101.1 billion.
The full-year 2026 estimated reported sales guidance midpoint represents 7.3% growth.
Innovative Medicine reported Q2 2026 sales of $16.4 billion.
Innovative Medicine Q2 2026 operational sales growth was 6.8%, excluding translational currency.
Innovative Medicine growth was driven by DARZALEX, CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI, RYBREVANT/LAZCLUZE, TREMFYA, SPRAVATO and CAPLYTA.
MedTech reported Q2 2026 sales of $8.9 billion.
MedTech Q2 2026 operational sales growth was 3.6%, excluding translational currency.
MedTech growth was driven by wound closure, biosurgery, electrophysiology, Shockwave, contact lenses and trauma products.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was increased by $0.13 to a midpoint of $11.68.
The full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint represents 8.2% growth.
Full-year 2026 adjusted operational EPS guidance was increased by $0.18 to a midpoint of $11.58.
The full-year 2026 adjusted operational EPS guidance midpoint represents 7.3% growth.
The company stated it does not provide GAAP financial measures on a forward-looking basis due to uncertainties in legal proceedings and acquisition-related expenses.
Non-GAAP free cash flow for the second quarter of 2026 was estimated at approximately $8.7 billion.
claims.note: Repeat of the period error: the ~$8,700M estimate is second-quarter year-to-date 2026, not the quarter alone.

claims.claim: The company announced an investment of more than $1 billion to strengthen U.S. Vision manufacturing in Jacksonville, Florida.
The company announced the acquisition of Firefly Bio, Inc. to expand its oncology pipeline.
STELARA negatively impacted Innovative Medicine operational growth by approximately 760 basis points in Q2 2026.
The release cites the planned separation of the Orthopaedics business as a risk factor.
TREMFYA was newly approved in the quarter for use in active psoriatic arthritis.
CAPLYTA was newly approved in the quarter for the prevention of relapse in schizophrenia.
